description: This file defines REST API routes for managing notes, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes. It uses FastAPI for routing, SQLAlchemy ORM for database interaction, and depends on external modules for authentication and data models.

methods.name: create_note(note: models.NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: DBUser = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new note for the authenticated user, creates tags if they don't exist, and returns the created note.

methods.name: list_notes( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: DBUser = Depends(auth.get_current_user), search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by search term in title or content"), tag: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by tag name"), )
methods.description: Lists all notes for the current user, with optional filtering by search term and tag.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: DBUser = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID if the user owns it.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: int, note: models.NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: DBUser = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the title, content, and tags of a note if the user owns it.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: DBUser = Depends(auth.get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a note if the user owns it.
